decisions.reason: Correctly explains entry 200 vs sibling 404s via module-graph resolution relative to the chunk URL, siblings not shipped/packaged, and prescribes a self-contained single-chunk bundle with splitting disabled (inlineDynamicImports/manualChunks/splitting:false) plus packaging closure.

Precise mechanism: fileURLToPath keeps E: while realpathSync yields the volume's e:, case-sensitive startsWith rejects a contained file; explains Linux (no drive) and C:\ (case agreement) passes; avoids the folklore claims.

Canonicalizes base and target through the same realpathSync, win32-only case folding (identity on POSIX), whole-segment trailing sep, equivalent path.relative idiom rejecting ''/'.'/../absolute after resolution; keeps JS MIME type; guard retained.

Identifies bubbling wheel with two handlers, gives modal exclusive ownership via stopPropagation+preventDefault (or capture interceptor/ownership gate) while the pane handler stands down; notes preventDefault alone is not exclusivity.

Strong planned matrix for incident 1 (fallback/deployable closure, route GET) and incident 3 (exactly one zoom effect, pane unchanged, default path), and case-divergence serving on Windows; but no explicit planned check that real traversal or symlink escape is refused.
